paragraphs: Choni the Younger. In the Tosefta at the end of Rosh Hashanah, Beit Hillel said to Beit Shammai: “In the presence of all of you, the elders of Beit Shammai, did not Choni the Younger descend before the congregation and say seven [blessings], and all the people said to him, etc.?”
